core_hypothesis.architecture: TRANSPORT_ALGEBRA -> ACTION_SUFFICIENT_QUOTIENT q -> INDEPENDENT_LOCAL_GATE g -> ACTION y

lane_A_second_bridge.goal: Find a mechanistically distinct fresh complete 2x2 packet with independent q and g and freeze q/g semantics before outcome.
lane_A_second_bridge.strong_pass: All four cells source/test-supported and hosted; no mechanism-local parameter.

lane_B_end_to_end.goal: Find a fresh mechanism where q is generated by an upstream transport/normalization/negotiation process rather than supplied as an arbitrary test bit.
required_chain: frozen action-sufficient quotient Q yielding q
lane_B_end_to_end.strong_packet: At least two materially different source states map through T/Q to q=0 and q=1, and both are crossed with g=0/1.
lane_B_end_to_end.strong_pass: The same frozen AND decision applies end-to-end without mechanism-specific rescue.
lane_B_end_to_end.support_only: q is merely injected as a Boolean test fixture with no upstream transport/quotient evidence.

lane_C_property_algebra_coupling.goal: Test whether property-indexed transport state q can couple to the same local AND decision without changing property semantics.
lane_C_property_algebra_coupling.strong_pass: One fresh shared boundary produces property-specific q states that feed the same gate grammar.

boolean_rival_ecology.adjudication: A complete 2x2 packet selects exactly one listed truth table when exact; AND loses if any fresh cell disagrees.

U0_SINGLE_UNIFIED_ARCHITECTURE.claim: A common transport→Q→AND-gate architecture spans at least two mechanistically distinct prospective bridge families and at least one end-to-end packet.

U1_TWO_FAMILY_WITH_SHARED_INTERFACE.claim: Path/surface families remain distinct; they merely export the same binary q interface into a common local AND gate.

U2_BRIDGE_SUBCLASS_ONLY.claim: AND is real but only for a bounded negotiation/capability subclass; no general architecture spanning current exact families.

U3_DISCONNECTED.claim: Second prospective bridge fails; P24 quic result was mechanism-local/bounded.

U0_over_U1_requires: second mechanistically distinct prospective bridge PASS
same Q semantics up to predeclared isomorphism
identifiability_rule.U0_not_unique_if: U1 induces identical predictions on every admitted packet without extra parameters.

mathematical_targets.statement: A complete 2x2 truth table identifies one Boolean function extensionally among the frozen eight standard rivals.

If two decompositions share the same q and local AND map on all observed packets, action outputs alone cannot distinguish whether q came from one unified transport architecture or distinct family-specific generators.
U0 gains empirical content only if T and Q are themselves frozen and tested on held-out source states, not merely if final q×g outputs match.
Given frozen T,Q,D, a failed end-to-end cell can be localized to transport, quotient, or decision layer without altering the other layers.
